=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_scan.py:364-370 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_rebuilt_labels` only restores `ai:security-audit` when the tracker body is in `details.json`, but the poller rotates and truncates the failed-project batch to 30 (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25184-25191), so a rotated-out tracker is treated as a project and the judge can close it.
  WHY: This breaks the "Never close the tracker" requirement on those ticks. Severity disagreement: minimax=MAJOR, glm=NIT, and the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 examined this and rejected it, because `select` still skips such an item as `blocked_too_recently` or `no_details`.
- tests/test_security_audit_tracker_pipeline_exclude.py:162 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The assertion at line 162 does not distinguish "body present, no marker" from "body absent from details (rotation)", so it cannot catch the rotation regression.
  WHY: A regression that drops the tracker body would still pass the test. Severity is MAJOR in the source.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Never close the tracker, and never edit its body or its last-sha marker." (linked issue #9730)
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_scan.py `_rebuilt_labels` (lines 364-370) and its caller
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No fail-closed path exists for a tracker whose body is missing from details.json under the 30-item GraphQL rotation at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25184-25191.
- requirement: "When such a tracker carries ai:blocked, or any pipeline phase label (ai:clarification, ai:planning and similar), remove those labels."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_security_audit_tracker_release_pipeline_labels` allowlist
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The allowlist at line 303 omits `ai:validation-failed`, which is a pipeline phase in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1533 and an unblock stop label in scripts/unblock_ledger.py:146. The release helper leaves it on a marked tracker. Source severity is NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
